essence: The practitioner must perform the rite as before, in the manner prescribed for the ten-syllabled mantra.
The three-syllabled ceṭī formula is defined by its syllable count and association with three elements.
Warriors who afflict enemies are the prescribed reciters of this mantra.
The three-syllabled Sarasvatī mantra adopts the same preliminary elements as the ten-syllabled mantra and has Sarasvatī as its deity.
After performing the preliminaries, the practitioner should meditate on the goddess Sarasvatī.
